draft.weaknessQuote: Dismissed from Clemson prior to 2021 spring practices.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.96, the 161st-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 18th of 37 at CB. He lasted until pick 212, well after his grade rank (161st): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Darius Phillips. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (0th percentile). College production: 3 passes defended in 2021, 27th of 31 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Dallas Cowboys (practice squad). 47 career games and 18 starts over 3 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 4 in 2023. Strengths in 2025: interceptions 2 (82nd percentile). Weak spots: approximate value 1 (17th percentile), season snap share 12.0% (19th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 cornerback who played: 12.0% season snap share against a median of 34.8%, below the norm.
